description: One region in numbers, for a news story or a briefing: open calls (regional and national), grants, calls closing in 30 days, calls opened in the last 12 months against the 12 before, the largest regional calls open now, the recurring calls expected in the next 90 days, and house prices (OMI quotations of the Agenzia delle Entrate) with the cheapest towns.
name: region_brief
title: I bandi di una regione in numeri
